y = true_w * x + true_b + 0.3 * torch.randn_like(x)

w = torch.randn(1, requires_grad=True)

lr = 0.01

code:
for epoch in range(200):
    y_pred = w * x + b
    loss = ((y_pred - y) ** 2).mean()

    w.grad = None
    b.grad = None
    loss.backward()

    with torch.no_grad():
        w -= lr * w.grad
        b -= lr * b.grad
